description: React component for shopping cart summary, handling order placement, payment processing (cash, UPI with Razorpay), and receipt display.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears customer name, mobile number, and cart contents.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Sets showPopup to true and clears customer info.

methods.name: deleteOrderOnFailure
methods.description: Deletes an order by ID, handles errors.

methods.name: completePayment
methods.description: Handles payment process for cash and UPI, including Razorpay integration.

methods.name: verifyPaymentHandler
methods.description: Verifies Razorpay payment and updates order details.
